src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate uniform divider giving equal-size panels (vertical or horizontal).
    for c in range(w):
        if c == w-c-1 and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            pairs = [(left[r][j], right[r][j]) for r in range(h) for j in range(c)]
            break
    else:
        for r in range(h):
            if r == h-r-1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
                left = grid[:r]
                right = grid[r+1:]
                pairs = [(left[i][j], right[i][j]) for i in range(r) for j in range(w)]
                break
    common = set(a for a,b in pairs) & set(b for a,b in pairs)
    bg = min(common) if len(common) == 1 else max(common, key=lambda x: sum(a==x or b==x for a,b in pairs))
    if len(left) and len(left[0]) == 0: pass
    if len(grid[0]) > len(grid):
        if len(left)==len(grid):
            return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else bg for j in range(len(left[0]))] for i in range(h)]
        return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(left))]
    return [[3 if left[i][j] == right[i][j] else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(left))]
'''

src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split into two equal panels at a uniform divider row or column.
    split = None
    for c in range(w):
        if c == w - c - 1 and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            split = ("vertical", c)
            break
    if split is None:
        for r in range(h):
            if r == h - r - 1 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
                split = ("horizontal", r)
                break
    orient, k = split
    if orient == "vertical":
        a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
        b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        a = grid[:k]
        b = grid[k+1:]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    background = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
'''
